note: Frozen Gate 0 answers, reused verbatim across the 4 runs of the PublicColumnHeader refactor so results stay comparable. Supply the brief with --brief=.sdlc/briefs/refactor-public-column-header.md
stack: TypeScript/Node ESM pnpm monorepo (React + Vite web app)

known_policy_gap.summary: opus-plus-flash-v37 codegen rule matches an explicit task_type list containing react_component but NOT the brownfield primitives new_file_add / existing_file_edit.
known_policy_gap.consequence: Packets typed with the brownfield primitives fall through to `default: opus` and run mechanical codegen at premium rates. Failure is SILENT — the run succeeds and telemetry shows nothing wrong.
known_policy_gap.workaround: Set task_type: react_component and carry the brownfield primitive in `subtype`.
known_policy_gap.reason: Four runs of this task are compared on cost. A run that omits this workaround pays opus rates for the same 3 codegen packets and the comparison is invalid.
known_policy_gap.fix_properly: Add new_file_add / existing_file_edit to the codegen rule task_type list in the policy YAML, rather than bending per-run.

comparability_rules: Apply known_policy_gap.workaround identically in every run (task_type: react_component, primitive in subtype).
Report the pipeline total EXCLUDING the pre-check smoke; runs 2-4 skip pre-check (cached), so folding it in only inflates run 1.
Revert the previous run before starting the next (/mmo:revert <run-id>) — otherwise the extraction already exists and there is nothing to do.
Retry the Vertex 429 with a 60s backoff rather than counting the failed dispatch as a packet; run 1 hit it on the first mechanical dispatch.

auth_mode=estimated means direct-tier (claude-cli) costs are ESTIMATES. Run 1 corrected three of them upward from subagent-reported token totals after the char heuristic undercounted per-turn context re-send. Any run that skips that correction reads artificially low on the opus share.

open_methodology_question.issue: Under auth_mode=estimated the premium tier runs in-session via claude-cli and its cost is inferred, not vendor-reported. That is the largest source of noise in a cost comparison.
open_methodology_question.option: Running the whole set under --auth vendor would make every figure vendor-reported and remove the variable.
open_methodology_question.caveat: Not a free switch: vendor dispatches every model through the MCP server, so it likely also forces a policy whose premium adapter is builtin-anthropic (e.g. opus-plus-flash) rather than claude-cli. That changes what is being compared and bills a real ANTHROPIC_API_KEY instead of the subscription.
open_methodology_question.decision: UNRESOLVED - user call, not recorded as decided.
